Title: LSJ: Predator's Transformation, skill card and diablerie

Messages.Author: Fabio 'Sooner' Macedo
Messages.Body:
Hi,

As always, I'm having problems with the whole diablerie process :P

Vamp A has [abo] commits diablerie on Vamp B, who is older.
Vamp A gains all of B's blood, his equipment, and a skill card, which
happens to be Abombwe.
Vamp A's controller plays Predator's Transformation at superior.
Finally, the Blood Hunt starts.

Is this sequence legal and correct?
I've found a post (http://tinyurl.com/y482v2) where LSJ says Predator's
Transformation is played after action resolution.

Following the precedent on Freak Drive, I'd say that it can only be
played after the Blood Hunt, not before.
But I've noticed that there is no more numbered and ordered "steps" in
the diablerie process, and the Blood Hunt is not "step 5" anymore - it
is conducted after the diablerie. Which is fine, since the diablerie is
a single unit.

In short, has this different organization of text in the rulebook
changed anything on how modifiers like Freak Drive or Predator's
Transformation are handled in a diablerie action?

Thanks,

Fabio "Sooner" Macedo

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:

> As always, I'm having problems with the whole diablerie process :P

> Vamp A has [abo] commits diablerie on Vamp B, who is older.

> happens to be Abombwe.
> Vamp A's controller plays Predator's Transformation at superior.
> Finally, the Blood Hunt starts.
>
> Is this sequence legal and correct?

Yes.

> I've found a post (http://tinyurl.com/y482v2) where LSJ says Predator's
> Transformation is played after action resolution.

Right, so after the diablerie (the same window as the blood hunt referendum, in
this case).

> Following the precedent on Freak Drive, I'd say that it can only be
> played after the Blood Hunt, not before.

Freak Drive is "Only usable at the end of a successful action"
PT is "when this vampire burns a minion controlled by your prey"

Messages.Author: Fabio 'Sooner' Macedo
Messages.Body:
LSJ wrote:

> Fabio 'Sooner' Macedo wrote:
> > I've found a post (http://tinyurl.com/y482v2) where LSJ says Predator's
> > Transformation is played after action resolution.
>
> Right, so after the diablerie (the same window as the blood hunt referendum, in

Oh, that explains a lot. Thanks.

I take it that the Abombwe user can't use PT after the Blood Hunt,
right?
(say, his controller discards a political action card to gain a vote
during the Blood Hunt and replaces it with PT).

Fabio "Sooner" Macedo

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


He can. That's the "same window" bit. Things that happen in the "same window"
can be ordered as the player sees fit.

Messages.Author: Fabio 'Sooner' Macedo
Messages.Body:


OK. I suppose this takes into consideration that even if the BH is not
an effect controlled by anyone, someone should have the prerogative to
order the effects, and it falls on the controller of the acting
minion's purview.

Fabio "Sooner" Macedo
